const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python - <<'PY'
import wave,numpy as np
w=wave.open('assets/boom.wav','rb'); sr=w.getframerate(); x=np.frombuffer(w.readframes(w.getnframes()),dtype='<i2').astype(float)/32768
N=1024; hop=220; win=np.hanning(N); freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(N,1/sr)
# mel banks
mel=lambda f:2595*np.log10(1+f/700); im=lambda m:700*(10**(m/2595)-1)
edges=im(np.linspace(mel(80),mel(8000),28)); bins=np.searchsorted(freqs,edges)
fb=np.zeros((26,len(freqs)))
for j in range(26):
 a,b,c=bins[j:j+3]; fb[j,a:b]=np.arange(b-a)/max(1,b-a); fb[j,b:c]=np.arange(c-b,0,-1)/max(1,c-b)
D=np.cos(np.pi/26*(np.arange(26)+.5)[:,None]*np.arange(13)[None,:])
rows=[]
for s in range(30):
 z=x[s*sr:(s+1)*sr]; fs=[]; pitches=[]
 for i in range(0,len(z)-N+1,hop):
  q=z[i:i+N]; rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(q*q))
  if rms<.015: continue
  sp=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(q*win))**2
  lm=np.log(fb@sp+1e-8); mf=lm@D
  fs.append(mf)
  # pitch autocorr clipped lag 45-300 Hz
  qq=q-q.mean(); ac=np.correlate(qq,qq,'full')[N-1:]; lo=int(sr/300); hi=int(sr/65); lag=lo+np.argmax(ac[lo:hi]); pitches.append(sr/lag)
 F=np.array(fs); m=np.mean(F,0) if len(F) else np.zeros(13)
 rows.append(m)
 print(f'{s:02d} voiced={len(F):2d} f0={np.median(pitches) if pitches else 0:6.1f} mf=', ' '.join(f'{v:7.2f}' for v in m[1:7]))
# custom kmeans standardized MFCC1:12 plus f? test many seeds and print best
X=np.array(rows)[:,1:13]; X=(X-X.mean(0))/(X.std(0)+1e-9)
best=None
for seed in range(100):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed); c=X[rng.choice(30,3,False)]
 for _ in range(100):
  lab=((X[:,None]-c[None])**2).sum(2).argmin(1); nc=np.array([X[lab==j].mean(0) if np.any(lab==j) else c[j] for j in range(3)])
  if np.allclose(c,nc): break
  c=nc
 loss=((X-c[lab])**2).sum()
 if best is None or loss<best[0]:best=(loss,lab)
print('cluster',best[0], ''.join(map(str,best[1])))
PY","workdir":"/app","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":5000}); text(r.output)
